title: Patients' Expectations About the Survival Benefits of Cancer Drugs Approved Based on Progression-Free Survival
official: Patients' Expectations About the Survival Benefits of Cancer Drugs Approved Based on Progression-Free Survival: a Randomized Controlled Trial
summary: This study of current or former cancer patients will evaluate whether communicating data on overall survival data in addition to information on progression-free improves the accuracy of cancer patients' expectations about the survival benefits of new cancer drugs

interventions.name: FDA explanation for progression-free survival with overall survival data
NCI explanation for progression-free survival with overall survival data
Plain-language explanation of progression-free survival with overall survival data

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* US adults with a current or former cancer diagnosis (excluding nonmelanoma skin cancer)
* US adults 18 years of age and older, fluent in English, and residing in the United States.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Adults who do not have a former cancer diagnosis or who were diagnosed with nonmelanoma skin cancer; adults who complete the survey in under 150 seconds, and who do not meet the other inclusion criteria.
sponsor: London School of Economics and Political Science

sites.f: Harvard Medical School and Harvard Pilgrim Health Care Institute
